metadata.description: Apra Labs skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers for Claude Code

plugins.name: bitbucket-devops
plugins.description: Bitbucket Cloud pipelines, pull requests and deployments from Claude Code: check status, analyse failures, download logs, trigger builds. Requires Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: rport
plugins.description: Guardrails for RPort servers (rportd/openrport): stored tunnels, revive, expiry, repointing fleet members; the API token stays in apra-fleet. Requires apra-fleet 0.4.5+ and Node.js 18+.
